text: The package spawned curl to query the EC2 metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254 for IAM credentials, instance ID, region and identity info, and it attempted contact with oastify.com, a data-collection service, while sending this machine's name to an outside host. The scan recorded honeytokens for AWS keys, a GitHub token, metadata credentials and an npm token leaving the sandbox, which is the behavior of a credential stealer. Do not merge this package; treat any credentials present in the build environment as compromised and rotate them, and investigate how the dependency was introduced.
